text:
mara: quick flag - onboarding sample harness found intermittent vector dim mismatch for rerank. seeing 1536 vs 1535.
kevin: is this reproducible? any stack or logs?
mara: intermittent, seems tied to auth refresh under burst. sequence: token refresh triggers retry, batch helper re-enqueues an item and the final batch ends up missing one value. server rejects with dims mismatch.
ryan: paste the error we get from the API pls
mara: server log: 
```
[2026-03-20T21:05:14Z] ERROR embeddings.api: batch_rejected bad_request expected_dim=1536 got_dim=1535 batch_id=onboard-77
```
kevin: ah i've seen that. bug in Node batching helper where splice/slice math used when a chunk is split on retry. off-by-one edge when requeueing the tail.
alex: python sampleapp hides it by auto-padding short vectors with zeros so some users never see the error which makes debugging worse.
mara: customers hit this during onboarding and it's confusing.
ryan: short-term mitigation: add a pre-send validator in SDKs/samples to fail-fast and return a clear error with metadata (expected,given,index). also avoid re-enqueueing the same item twice during auth retry.
kevin: propose SDK parity change: add `strictShape=true` default in embedding/rerank helpers. When true, reject mismatches. When false, pad/trim but emit a warning and metric. This keeps sampleapps explicit.
mara: can we get a tiny hotfix in samples + helper libs so onboarders see the clear 400 instead of silent pads?
kevin: yes, i pushed a tiny guard in Node helper and a matching change for python sample in a branch.
ryan: i'll add a unit test that simulates auth refresh mid-batch (force token expiry and trigger retry path). that'll catch requeue duplication.
kevin: snippet for validator (js):
```js
function validateBatchShapes(vecs, expect) {
  for (let i = 0; i < vecs.length; i++) {
    if (!Array.isArray(vecs[i]) || vecs[i].length !== expect) {
      return {ok:false, idx:i, got: vecs[i] ? vecs[i].length : 'non-array'};
    }
  }
  return {ok:true};
}
```
alex: i'll update the sample README to explicitly document `strictShape` and how to enable `pad_on_mismatch` if someone needs legacy behavior.
ci-bot: Created issue DE-1472: "batching helper: validate shapes + prevent duplicate requeue on auth refresh" (https://git.internal/redwood/issues/DE-1472)
devex-bot: Canary build queued for devex/helpers with shape-guard patch - build 4901
mara: tested local repro with strictShape=true, errors surface correctly and onboarding flow can show a helpful message. good for now.
kevin: follow-up: add telemetry metric `embed_invalid_dim` with tag `sample_app` so we can monitor onboarding friction.
ryan: agreed; will add metric and a tiny alert if rate spikes during a rollout.
mara: thanks team. i'll coordinate docs + sample update and close when CI passes.
